stories.goal: Install DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 on x570 with a fixed Home and the same usable model configuration
stories.value: Use the same model roster on x570 without moving private sessions or disturbing the existing installation
stories.given: x570 has the preserved legacy ~/.dsh and the approved settings and credential sources
stories.when: the owner starts dsh from a login shell and boots the fixed-home Web profile
stories.then: dsh resolves to the rc.6 launcher using /home/chriswang/.local/dsh_home, exposes the approved 7-provider/35-model configuration, keeps configuration files private, copies no session/workspace state, leaves ~/.dsh unchanged, and serves loopback HTTP 200
